translations.web: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
translations.bsb: An offended brother is harder to win than a fortified city, and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
translations.kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
translations.asv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city; And such contentions are like the bars of a castle.
